sections.heading:
Meet your
next tutor.
sections.body: Patient, one-to-one lessons that help your child make sense of schoolwork and feel more confident asking questions.
sections.imageAlt: Illustrative portrait of the sample tutor holding a book

sections.label: MY TEACHING APPROACH
sections.heading: Make it click.
sections.body: I start by finding the step that feels confusing. Then we work through an example together and your child tries a similar one on their own.

cards.heading: Learn by doing
cards.body: We draw, discuss and practise so I can see how your child is thinking.

cards.heading: A pace that fits
cards.body: We leave room for questions and spend extra time where it makes a difference.

sections.label: WHAT WE CAN WORK ON
sections.heading: Subjects I teach
sections.body: Sample lesson options for upper primary and secondary students.

cards.heading: Mathematics
cards.body: Build confidence with fractions, algebra and word problems through worked examples.

cards.heading: Science & Physics
cards.body: Connect diagrams and everyday examples to the ideas behind the formulas.

cards.heading: English Literature
cards.body: Read closely, discuss what a text means and practise writing clear arguments.

cards.heading: Tell me what’s tricky
cards.body: Share your child’s year level, subject and a topic or homework question they’d like help with.

cards.heading: Try a short lesson
cards.body: We’ll work through an example together, then give your child a chance to try a similar question.

cards.heading: Talk through next steps
cards.body: After the trial, I’ll share what I noticed and what we could practise next.

sections.label: YOUR FIRST LESSON
sections.heading: Let’s get started!
sections.body: Tell me your child’s year level and one topic they find tricky. We’ll find a time for a free trial lesson so you can see how tutoring feels.
